messages.author: Felix Brandt
messages.text: Is Android ARPDAU affected by the 2.14.0 issue? Trying to size the revenue impact.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: ARPDAU (revenue / DAU from daily_kpis, all users) is pretty stable on both platforms, iOS roughly 2x Android as usual. The impact is in volume: new Android cohorts retain worse, so Android DAU has been sliding faster than iOS since late July. Revenue follows DAU, not ARPDAU.

replies.author: Felix Brandt
replies.text: Makes sense, thanks. 2.15.0 is in QA, targeting Sep 3.
